unknown-field-runner.sentence: Not valid: the procedure has a field Ophiolite does not know; check its spelling.

digest-typed.sentence: Not valid: Ophiolite works out the code's fingerprint itself; remove it from procedure.json.

missing-label.sentence: Not valid: the procedure is missing a required field.

wrong-schema.sentence: Not valid: procedure.json must say it is an Ophiolite procedure, version 1.

label-email.sentence: Not valid: the procedure needs a readable label, for example "Depth shift".

version-boolean.sentence: Not valid: the version must be a whole number from 1 to 1000000.

version-label-snake.sentence: Not valid: the version label needs a readable label, for example "Depth shift".

version-label-engineering.sentence: Not valid: the version label uses a word meant for technical details; describe it in everyday words.

step-unknown.sentence: Not valid: the step must be one of read, source, process, send or check.

read-with-version-input.sentence: Not valid: input 1 is not an input this step can read.

process-input-segy.sentence: Not valid: input 1 names a type of data this step cannot use.

head-pattern-double-anchor.sentence: Not valid: input 1 gives a pattern that is not plain text; patterns are literal text, optionally starting with ^.
